'''Joel Jackson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Lompoc tournament]] on 9 December 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]], according to Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1519">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-lompoc-12-9-00d1519/ lompoc-12-9-00], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 9 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-lompoc-12-9-00d1519/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
